.. _Changelog:

===========
Changelog
===========

Version 1.2.0 (July 28, 2026)
----------------------------------

* Slight update to metric
* Added the generalized form of the metric for any given integer value of p
* Changed the way that weights are input:
    * The ability to input a 2-d matrix of weights is now an option
    * `comp_to_first = True` now simply sets some of the 2-d matrix of weights to 0

Version 1.0.1 (January 20, 2026)
----------------------------------

* Updates to documentation and pyproject.toml.

Version 1.0.0 (January 15, 2026)
----------------------------------

* Initial release of the MiLoMerge package
